scope: Use the separately preserved, native-journey-verified 5.6 venue candidate as the compatible save fallback. It already owns the new campaign, workspace, vessel and Backpack fields; production 5.5.1 is the upgrade starting point, not an assumed safe writer of newer progress. This fallback retains the pre-hotfix road behavior and is an emergency compatibility package, not the primary release. Before any production promotion its environment must be configured and verified for production. Exact source differences are pinned below; actual upgrade/fallback/write/return is required.

app/index.html.review: Opt-in scenery UI and copy; same preference key; no player schema change.

app/js/terrain/published-road-integrity..review: Checks at-grade contact across staged and pinned owners with unchanged precision. No persistent data.

app/js/terrain/rebuild.js.review: Removes whole-world recovery callback and accepts the pinned engineered contact owner. No save fields or player identity changes.

app/js/terrain/regional-scenery-schedule.review: Absent preference now means fixed location; explicit on/off values remain unchanged. No other keys affected.

app/js/terrain/transport-detail-compiler.review: Allows a reconstructed worker to defer its initial packets. Pure transient compiler state.

app/js/terrain/transport-detail-runtime..review: Bounded local worker retry preserves accepted meshes, actor, world and save state. No stored schemas.

app/js/world/compiler/transport-junction.review: Includes all graph junctions on an already-engineered approach in existing grade constraints and audits. Derived terrain/road state only.

config/production-program-gates.json.review: Updates candidate identity, current production baseline and acceptance document; no runtime player data.

config/public-feature-claims.json.review: Candidate version only; public claims unchanged.

config/public-gallery.json.review: Candidate version only; image source-build provenance retained.

config/runtime-dependencies.json.review: Pins the version-only package-lock update; dependency versions/integrities unchanged.

config/system-release-gates.json.review: Adds native junction-driving and fault-recovery requirements; no game data or security changes.

package-lock.json.review: Root release version only; dependency graph unchanged.

package.json.review: Release version only; scripts and dependency declarations unchanged.
